# Combine downloaded songs from both pages into a dict: song_id -> duration
downloaded_songs = downloaded + downloaded2
downloaded_map = {song['song_id']: song['duration'] for song in downloaded_songs}
print("Downloaded song count:", len(downloaded_map))

# Fetch each playlist and check if all its songs are downloaded and total duration >= 1800s
for pl in playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(access_token=login_result['access_token'], playlist_id=pl_id)
    songs = pl_detail['songs']
    song_ids = [s['id'] for s in songs]
    all_downloaded = all(sid in downloaded_map for sid in song_ids)
    total_duration = sum(downloaded_map[sid] for sid in song_ids if sid in downloaded_map)
    print(f"Playlist {pl_id} ({pl['title']}): songs={len(song_ids)}, all_downloaded={all_downloaded}, total_duration={total_duration}s")
    if all_downloaded and total_duration >= 1800:
        print("SUITABLE PLAYLIST FOUND:", pl_id)
        break
